C1578.title: AI Model Manipulation and Adversarial Threats in AIoT Environments
C1578.summary: This research paper examines how attackers can manipulate AI models in AIoT environments using evasion, poisoning, backdoor embedding, model extraction, and inference attacks. These attacks threaten the security and trustworthiness of AIoT systems, highlighting the real-world risks of converged AIoT attacks.
